title: Turning on 'Take payments in the member app' never says which members will see the Pay now button
what: The tick box says it shows members a Pay now button in the MettleUp app for what they owe. The button only shows to a member who has the app, signed in with the same mobile number the gym has for them. Members not on the app, or on it with another number, see nothing, and the owner cannot see who is which. At Crispy Curves 0 of 2 members are linked to the app, so with the box ticked nobody can be shown to get the button. Nothing tells a member the button is there either: they only find it if they open My membership.
expected: Under the tick box: 'X of Y members are on the app and will see Pay now', with a list of the others and why (not on the app, number does not match).
fix_line: Show under the box how many members will see Pay now, and who will not and why

title: When an entry machine stops reporting in, nobody is told
what: An entry machine that loses internet only turns to 'Offline. Check the machine has internet.' on its card in Settings. No pop-up, no line on Today and no message to the owner. While it is offline, renewals, freezes and cancels do not reach the door, so an expired member can still walk in and a renewed one can be kept out, until someone happens to open that Settings card. The feature is not switched on for any gym yet.
expected: When a machine has been offline for a while, a line on Today (and a message to the owner) says which machine and since when.
fix_line: Before entry machines go live, warn on Today when a machine goes offline
